artifact_before_ref: Plan before pass 5 had a shallow Section 4.3 with four quality layers and brief good/bad examples, but lacked score anchors, pass thresholds, failure taxonomy, reviewer notes, inter-rater handling, and an exact anti-token-overclaim comparison rule. Section 8 rows 4-5 were plain PASS rows without packet refs for completed passes. REVIEW.jsonl row 5 was ledger-only.

findings.summary: Quality scoring was not detailed enough to compare baseline/adaptive and prove improvement or non-regression for PromptToTask, OrchestrationReasoning, SkillSelection, and final usefulness.
findings.required_fix: Add per-layer score anchors, thresholds, pass/fail examples, failure taxonomy, reviewer notes, inter-rater handling, and comparison rules.

findings.summary: Token savings could still be overclaimed because the plan did not explicitly say that savings cannot compensate for quality regression in any layer.
findings.required_fix: Add an explicit rule that any adaptive quality drop, new failure code, failed layer, or inconclusive review blocks token-success claims.

findings.summary: Pass 5 was ledger-only; Section 8 row 5 and REVIEW.jsonl row 5 did not point to an inspectable evidence packet.
findings.required_fix: Create review-pass-05.md/json and update row 5 with evidence packet refs and ledger_rows_are_evidence=false.

recheck_evidence: Section 4.3 now requires separate PromptToTask, OrchestrationReasoning, SkillSelection, and Final output usefulness scores with score anchors 0..5 and PASS threshold >=4.
Section 4.3 now requires failure_codes, human_reviewer_note, quality_regression, reviewer_id, review_timestamp_utc, and inter_rater_status.
Section 4.3 now requires adaptive >= baseline in every layer and forbids averaging from hiding a failed layer.
Section 4.3 now says token savings cannot compensate for any quality regression, new failure code, failed layer, or inconclusive review.
Section 8 rows 1-5 now use packet refs for completed passes.
REVIEW.jsonl row 5 points to review-pass-05.md/json and sets ledger_rows_are_evidence=false.
